yd_listFailed: The adapter did not answer with its device list. Is the instance running?
yd_intro: Creates a diagnostics report for the selected receiver — read only, nothing on the receiver changes.
yd_containsWhat: what the receiver can do and what it answers
yd_after: Reading takes up to a minute. Attach the file to a GitHub issue afterwards.
yd_noDevices: This instance runs no device yet.
yd_offlineHint: The device is not connected: the report contains what the adapter remembers about it and the log lines, but no live read.
yd_exportFailed: The report could not be created.
yd_privacyMarkers: Addresses, serial numbers, network and room names are replaced by markers before the file leaves the adapter.
yd_privacyMemory: Nothing is written to disk — the report stays in memory only until your browser has it.
yd_generating: Generating the diagnostics report — the receiver is being read over every protocol it speaks. This takes up to a minute; the file is offered for download when it is done.
yd_notRunning: The instance is not running. Start it, then open this tab again.
yd_stopped: The instance stopped while the report was being made (a restart or a crash). Try again once it runs — the instance's log says what happened.
yd_noAnswer: The adapter did not answer within %s s. Check the instance's log, then try again.
